content: गुणनम् [गुण्-ल्युट्] .²1 Multiplication. .²2 Enumeration. .²3 Describing merits or qualities, pointing out or enumerating merits; इह रसभणने कृतहरिगुणने मधुरिपुपदसेवके <ls>Gīt. 7</ls>. .²4 Reiterated study, repetition. .{@-नी@} Examining books, studying; collating and correcting copies to determine the value of variants.
